text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Symboli Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf pointed toward a crane 
game. The prizes were Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Cherry, plum, peach, and damson—each 
blooms in its own way. There are all kinds 
of Umamusume. Don't you think there's a 
real charm to that?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would dearly love to display this in the 
student council room, but... Hmm, what to 
do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf fell silent, her gaze 
remaining fixed downward on the plushie.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not particularly familiar with 
amusement centers like this. I've never 
even touched a claw machine before."
choice_data_list: Could you leave this to me?
Could you leave this to me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right person for the right job, is it? I 
have no reason to refuse such an offer 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I expect great results. I'm 
counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
